summary: Workstation kitting for new hire + return scheduling for legacy VPN router
description:
Issue summary:
New hire joining in two days requires a pre-kitted workstation (laptop, docking station, power, mouse, keyboard, monitor arm). Separately, IT has a legacy VPN gateway router (asset tag VPR-0421) that needs scheduled pickup and return to central asset pool before new hardware deployment.

Impact:
If kitting is delayed the new hire will not have a functioning workstation on day 1. If the legacy router is not collected and reimaged, inventory and licensing reconciliation will be blocked.

Environment:
Onsite (US West office, Building A, 3rd floor) — new hire will be seated at hotdesk zone H3-14. Shipping pickup will originate from the same office mailroom.

Requested outcome:
1) Confirm kit contents and reserve items from storage.
2) Schedule courier to pick up legacy VPN router on 2026-03-11 between 10:00-14:00 PT.
3) Provision temporary door access for the mover (temp badge) and provide desk setup instructions to IT admin.

Steps already taken:
- Miguel opened this ticket and confirmed asset tag VPR-0421 exists in inventory.
- Inventory shows 1x laptop (reserve), 1x docking station, 1x monitor arm available.
- Hotdesk H3-14 reservation created for new hire 2026-03-12.

Acceptance criteria:
- Kit prepared and labeled in secure storage by EOD 2026-03-11.
- Courier pickup confirmed with tracking ID and ETA.
- Temporary access badge issued and returned after pickup.
- Asset VPR-0421 marked as In Transit and updated in asset tracker.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Miguel Santos: Added ticket with initial inventory check. Please confirm shipping vendor and temp badge process.
2026-03-10 - Jordan Blake (Facilities): We can issue a 1-day temp badge for the courier. Need courier name and ID to pre-authorize. Shipping partner suggested: ShipFast (account: REDWOOD-OPS).

2026-03-11 - Priya Nair (Assignee): Confirming I will reserve kit items and create the shipping manifest. Can Facilities pre-authorize temp badge for 'ShipFast Driver #43' for pickup window 10:00-14:00?
2026-03-11 - Jordan Blake (Facilities): Temp badge created: TEMP-3891 valid 2026-03-11 09:45-15:00. Please ensure courier signs chain-of-custody form. Badge to be returned to Mailroom.
2026-03-12 - Miguel Santos: Courier pickup completed. Tracking: SF-94827123. Router scanned out by Mailroom (scan by Anna P.). Please update ticket with tracking and mark asset In Transit.

2026-03-12 - Priya Nair: Kit staged in storage bay B2, labeled 'INT-16205 - H3-14'. Laptop assigned asset tag LAP-7810. Monitor arm and dock logged. Created return label and uploaded manifest to Confluence page. Scheduling follow-up to confirm new hire first-day sign-on.
investigation_notes: Checked asset registry: VPR-0421 last seen 2026-02-28 assigned to retired gateway rack. No open change requests. License count shows one extra license if returned.
Validated kit inventory against Kitting checklist v3.2. Missing: USB-C cable (1x). Placed internal order to procurement for same-day pickup. Order PO-33422.
Reviewed camera logs near mailroom to verify courier arrival window; timestamps match ShipFast manifest. Mailroom scan log entry: 2026-03-12 11:07 by Anna P. (mailroom).
Temporary badge audit: TEMP-3891 issued and returned to Mailroom at 14:52 on 2026-03-11. No exceptions recorded.
resolution: Workstation kit prepared and staged; missing USB-C cable fulfilled via PO-33422 and included. Carrier ShipFast picked up the legacy VPN router on 2026-03-11; tracking SF-94827123 confirmed delivery to central IT reprovisioning on 2026-03-12. Asset VPR-0421 status updated to 'In Transit' then to 'Received' after confirmation. Temp badge returned and logged. Follow-ups: INT-16217 created to reconcile license and close hardware decommissioning ticket. Ticket resolved operationally; keeping open until new hire confirms day-1 sign-on.
